newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Nov coffee exports 1.59 million bags - Febec.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Nov coffee exports 1.59 million bags - Febec.

text.p: Brazil exported 1.59 million 60-kg bags of coffee, ground and in beans, in November, below a slightly upwardly revised October figure of 1.90 million bags, said Brazilian Federation of Coffee Exporters (Febec).
The November total is virtually double the 801,006 bags exported in the same month last year.
Export receipts in November were $203.25 million, down from $236.49 million the previous month but substantially higher than the $112.06 raised in November 1995.
The average price per bag in November was $127.75, up from $124.63 in October but down from $139.90 in November 1995.
Of November's total, 1.56 million bags were arabica coffee, while shipments of conillon reached 30,000 bags.
Total shipments so far this year are now 11.15 million bags against 11.16 million exported in the first 11 months of 1995.
Revenue to November this year is $1.48 billion, down from the $1.84 billion raised by the same stage last year.
